name: Jiarong
notes: REGISTRY STUB (not a modelled G2P target). Placed so the ancestry graph covers every living ISO 639-3 language. No orthography or phonology is claimed: script is Zyyy (undetermined) until a cited description is encoded. Classification and coordinates follow Glottolog. No glottolog_code: Glottolog splits rGyalrong into multiple languages and assigns ISO [jya] to the family-level node jiar1240, which this field may not point at.
